title: Artera
tagline: Help artist find collectors and identify buyers aligned with their art style

prizes.title: Best AI Experience with OpenSea MCP

description: This project uses LLM's and MCP servers to find the Artists NFT collection using the Opensea MCP server and finding users who have purchased similar collections and to connect with collectors by finding their social links via the ETHID MCP server. This allows collectors and artist to both benefit from this increased networking
how_its_made: This project started with Vercel/s NextJS AI chatbot, React and Tailwind , we added GPT-5 support and then used the AI SDK to utilize the Opensea and ETHID MCP servers. A small bit of data is stored on Postgres and Redis is used to reconnect to a chat that has completed yet. Using the MCP servers allowed to perform more complex queries using natural language.
